paras: Application: Toyota GT86 / Subaru BRZ / Scion FR-S and 2022+ Toyota GR86 / Subaru BRZ – manual transmission only Part Type: Fuel hanger plumbing kit with stainless filter (return-style conversion) Part Number: 20-0966-03
The Radium fuel hanger plumbing kit converts the OEM returnless fuel system to a traditional return system. It includes everything needed to connect directly to the OEM or aftermarket fuel rails.
hl: Return-Style Conversion: Converts the OEM returnless system to a traditional return system
Check Valve Filter: Radium fuel filter with built-in check valve and stainless element (-03)
Chassis-Specific Mount: Filter mounts under the vehicle on a bolt-on bracket with heat exchanger filter mount
RA-Series Regulator: Adjustable RA-series fuel pressure regulator with tool-less adjustment
Inline Gauge: Fuel pressure gauge secures to the filter
Pump Setups: Supports single and dual pump configurations
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Hanger Plumbing Kit  with Stainless Filter for Subaru BRZ/Toyota 86
